whatWeDo.question: What we do?
whatWeDo.title: From custom software to AI-driven products
whatWeDo.description: We help companies adopt AI, and we build the software that makes it usable — from the ground up when nothing exists yet, or woven into what's already there.

data.title: Data analysis
data.headline: We build decisions grounded in data
data.description: We analyze, clean, and organize data so you can make the best decisions for your business.

apps.title: App development
apps.headline: We build custom apps
apps.description: Work from anywhere, right from the palm of your hand, we build apps tailored to your needs.

whoWeAre.headline: Built in the city where we grew up.
whoWeAre.body: We founded Connecta in Guatemala City to build the technology we always wished existed — for companies that deserve better than a template. Great design and state-of-the-art technology aren't features we add later; they're the standard we hold every product to, starting with our own.

design.title: Great design
design.description: Design turns our technology into tools you'll actually want to use every day.

stateOfTheArt.title: Innovation
stateOfTheArt.description: We believe innovation is the core driver of growth.

unique.title: Unique experiences
unique.description: We build custom technology that feels unique and just works, right from day one.

medassistant.title: Software for healthcare clinics
medassistant.description: Medassistant gives doctors and clinic managers control of their operation. From billing patients, generating invoices, managing payments, to following up on appointments and patients, all in one place.

hero.subtitle: Manage appointments, patients, sales and more.
hero.imageAlt: Doctor using tablet in a modern and bright clinic

preview.title: Medassistant
preview.description: An interface built for everyday work.

visitSummaries.title: Automated Visit Summaries
visitSummaries.description: Send a complete visit summary to your patient's email after the appointment. Informed patients in a single click.

profileAccess.title: Instant access to the clinical history
profileAccess.description: Patient-specific details. Access the full history, allergies and notes in seconds without digging through paper files.

paymentManagement.title: Flexible Payment Management
paymentManagement.description: Handle clinic finances with ease. Record full or partial payments, track outstanding balances, and manage invoices directly within the patient's file.

whatsapp.title: Answer your patients on WhatsApp, even when the clinic is closed
whatsapp.subtitle: The AI assistant answers your patients' most common questions in seconds, and your team steps in whenever needed. Never miss a message.

answers.title: Answers the usual questions
answers.description: Hours, services, prices, payment methods and location, using the information you loaded. Your patients get a reply at any hour.

schedule.title: Coordinates appointments
schedule.description: You'll be able to book and coordinate appointments directly in your clinic's calendar, with no phone calls or back and forth.

control.title: You stay in control
control.description: Take over any conversation whenever you want, reply from the same inbox and hand it back to the assistant when you're done. You can also turn it off or choose which topics it answers.

tzij.title: Tzij — Generative AI lab | Connecta
tzij.description: Tzij is a Connecta initiative to form a consortium that gathers and safeguards data in Mayan languages, with the communities as owners of their data.

hero.meaning: In K'iche', tzij means word and speech.
hero.intro: Tzij is an initiative to bring together data in Mayan languages, advancing technology development together with the peoples who own them.
hero.mapCaption: Relief of the surroundings of Q'umarkaj, Quiché. Data: Copernicus DEM GLO-30.

why.label: Why
why.title: AI is a key tool for the development of society.
why.text: We want to place the region at the forefront of technology, and to have a say in how models and the data that feeds them are developed.

consortium.label: The consortium
consortium.title: Before the model, the data. Before the data, the agreement.
consortium.text: Tzij begins as an initiative to form a consortium that gathers and safeguards data in Mayan languages. The peoples keep ownership of their data and decide how it is used.

ownership.title: Community ownership
ownership.text: The data belongs to the peoples who contribute it. They decide who uses it and for what.

consent.title: Prior consent
consent.text: Free and informed, in each community's language, before any data is gathered.

benefit.title: Shared benefit
benefit.text: What is built with this data returns value to the communities it comes from.

roadmap.label: Where we're headed
roadmap.title: Our goal: the first Mayan LLM, built on data it owns.
